events.title: Art Appears: Samia Halaby's Yellow Spiral at Louvre Abu Dhabi Park
events.venue: Louvre Abu Dhabi Park, Saadiyat Island
events.description: Guggenheim Abu Dhabi brings Samia Halaby's painting Yellow Spiral (1970) to Louvre Abu Dhabi Park for three days of short talks about the artist, a spiral-collage workshop inspired by her use of colour, and a contemporary art quiz. Register through the link in Guggenheim Abu Dhabi's Instagram bio.

events.description: A free community walk/run at Al Wahda Mall to close Dubai Fitness Challenge 2026, followed by fitze's official Guinness World Records ceremony for the most participants in a virtual walk/run event in a month.
